basic_info.description: This charming multi-family building is situated on the border of San Francisco's desirable Noe Valley and Dolores Heights neighborhoods. The property includes a spacious, full-floor 3-bedroom flat and two studio units above. A 3-car parking pad connects to an alley behind the building, and a lovely  deck is accessible from the upper units. Located on a larger-than-typical lot (116' by 31'), the property offers expansion potential for a savvy investor or developer. All units will be delivered vacant at close of escrow, presenting an excellent opportunity for an owner-occupier, developer, or investor to  acquire three vacant units with significant potential.
